name: Content Growth Coach
description: Take a link to your channel, profile or stream and it identifies what is limiting the account, ranks the fixes, and suggests the next posts. Works on YouTube, TikTok, X and streams; it reviews what is already published, so a new account gives it little to read.

official.title: Content Growth Coach by SmoresBoy
official.description: Paste your YouTube, TikTok, X, or stream. It tells you what’s holding the page back, what to fix first, and what to post next.
